news.title: CNN-News18 Appoints Muralidharan Kasiviswanathan as News Director - Converged Output
news.body: CNN-News18 has appointed Muralidharan Kasiviswanathan as its new News Director (Converged Output), marking his return to the network for a second stint. In his new role, Kasiviswanathan will head the channel's output across platforms. He will be responsible for driving strong editorial judgment, sharper storytelling, and consistent presentation, while ensuring smooth execution of news coverage across all time bands. His responsibilities will go far beyond the traditional television newsroom. As CNN-News18 pushes deeper into a digital-first approach, he will play a key leadership role across Connected TV and YouTube, helping build alignment, speed, and impact in how stories are delivered to audiences.
